abilities.name: Shield Breaker
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Grit when fighting an enemy with difficulty 8 or higher.

abilities.name: Iron Bulwark
abilities.text: Passive. Enemy dice cannot explode against you.

abilities.name: Close-Quarters Doctrine
abilities.text: Once per round, before a battle in your sector, you may ignore evade options to add +1 to that battle.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: Once per round, after battle or hazard damage is assigned to you, prevent 1 Wound. Weakness: when you roll movement, roll 2 dice and use the lower result.
